kurz: Milk is water with fat droplets, protein and milk sugar. Depending on what you do with these parts, you get cream, butter, yoghurt or cheese.
bild_im_kopf: Like a construction kit with three parts: fat, protein, sugar. Each dairy product uses a different part.
was_passiert: Cream is the separated fat and can be whipped. Bacteria sour milk sugar into lactic acid, which thickens the protein: yoghurt. Rennet or acid makes the protein curdle: cheese.
warum_wichtig: Explains why cream turns to butter, why milk catches on the bottom of the pan and why some cheeses melt and others do not.
faustregeln: Do not let milk boil hard; it catches and boils over.
For melting, grate cheese finely and do not let it get too hot.
